evals.prompt: My web design agency has a single homepage that lists everything we do: web design, SEO, branding, and Google Ads. We get almost zero organic leads. What should I change on the site?
evals.expected_output: Runs the skill's four phases. Phase 1 (spec): diagnoses the one-page site as the core problem, failing SVC-01: one page cannot rank for four different service SERPs because each service has its own keyword and intent; recommends one dedicated page per service plus a services hub, with a proposed URL per service, and applies the SVC spec table plus the common rows C-01 to C-27 by reference. Phase 2 (audit): runs or prescribes seo_audit.py and section_audit.py --type service on the existing homepage and maps findings to spec IDs. Phase 3 (benchmark): picks 3-5 ranking competitor service pages per service (and providers AI assistants name), runs page_benchmark.py --type service, reads block gaps and metrics below the median, and names the information gain. Phase 4 (build): for each page, prescribes the canonical 9-block wireframe (hero with above-the-fold CTA, client logos, benefits as outcomes, 3-4 step process, founder section with real photo and checkable credentials, 750+ word question-led SEO text block raised to the competitor median, formatted client reviews with a dated rating, 3+ question FAQ, final CTA with 2-3 related blog posts), the metadata pattern (service keyword in title, H1, slug, meta under 160 characters, first paragraph, bold once in the intro), visible pricing, the GEO layer (question-form H2s with direct 2-4 sentence answers, sourced statistics or quotations, Service, Person and Organization schema with sameAs) and the acceptance test (scripts re-run). Delivers the standard five-part deliverable: spec scorecard, audit findings, competitor benchmark, build, acceptance. Points to seo-keyword-research for keyword choice and seo-internal-linking for the mini silo.

evals.prompt: Write the complete structure and draft for a service page targeting 'emergency plumber lyon' for my company Dupont Plomberie. We answer calls 24/7 and reach most of Lyon in under an hour.
evals.expected_output: Runs the four phases for a new page. Phase 1: applies the SVC spec (one service and keyword, local placement with Lyon, SVC-24 rules where city pages are involved) plus the common C rows by reference. Phase 2: notes 'new page', so the audit is skipped. Phase 3: reads the SERP for 'emergency plumber lyon' (local pack signals a local page), picks 3-5 ranking competitor service pages and providers named by AI assistants, runs page_benchmark.py --type service, and sets the word target and information gain (for example the measured under-60-minute response time). Phase 4: delivers the build: a metadata table with the city in the title (about 50-60 characters, e.g. 'Emergency Plumber in Lyon | Dupont Plomberie'), slug /emergency-plumber-lyon/, handwritten meta description of 160 characters or fewer, H1 containing the keyword, and the keyword plus city bolded once in the first 100 words. Drafts all 9 wireframe blocks in order with click-to-call CTAs above the fold and after major sections, a founder block calling for a real photo, named story and checkable credentials, a 750+ word text block with question-form H2s including a pricing question answered with a price range in plain text, reviews in first name + situation + problem + result format with a rating showing platform, count and date, and a FAQ of 3+ People Also Ask style questions with direct answers. Flags Lyon in image alts. Provides a Service or LocalBusiness (Plumber) JSON-LD graph with the Organization reference, Person with sameAs and BreadcrumbList, FAQPage optional and no self-serving review markup, links 2-3 supporting blog posts, applies the GEO checklist (self-sufficient page, extractable facts like the under-60-minute response time, sourced statistic or quotation), uses {to confirm} placeholders for unknown facts, and ends with the acceptance test. Output follows the five-part deliverable (spec scorecard, audit findings, competitor benchmark, build, acceptance). Mentions the seo-local skill for the Google Business Profile side.

evals.prompt: My landing page for 'shopify cro agency' is about 300 words: a headline, three feature bullets, and a contact form at the bottom. It does not rank anywhere and converts poorly. Audit it and tell me how to fix it.
evals.expected_output: Runs the four phases as an audit. Phase 1 and Phase 2: runs or prescribes seo_audit.py and section_audit.py --type service on the page, then produces a spec scorecard marking the C and SVC rows Pass, Fail or Not verifiable, and a gap table mapping the page against the 9-block wireframe (hero, logos, benefits, process, founder, SEO text block, reviews, FAQ, final CTA plus related posts), marking most blocks missing. Phase 3: benchmarks 3-5 competitor pages ranking for 'shopify cro agency' (and agencies AI assistants name) with page_benchmark.py --type service, flags the 300-word count against the 750+ word floor and the competitor median as the real target, reads blocks and schema types the client lacks, and defines the information gain. Phase 4: calls out the single bottom CTA and prescribes CTAs above the fold and after each major section, rewriting feature bullets as client outcomes, adding a named founder with a real photo and checkable credentials for E-E-A-T, formatted reviews with a dated rating, a 3+ question FAQ from People Also Ask, visible pricing or a range, semantic bolding and placement, and honest claims (no unsourced 'best', a disclaimer on results promises). Includes the GEO layer pass: question-form H2s with direct answers, sourced statistics and quotations citing the Princeton GEO findings, machine-readable Service, Person and Organization schema, AI crawler access via seo-technical. Delivers the five-part deliverable (spec scorecard, audit findings with a prioritized high/medium/low fix list, competitor benchmark, build or change list, acceptance with the scripts re-run).
